title: Differential Impact of Social Isolation and Space Radiation on Behavior and Motor Learning in Rats
mission: Ground Analog (15 cGy 5-ion GCRsim + Social Isolation)
iss_medbay_module: Behavioral & Circadian Pod (Mental Health & Motor Log)
assays: EEG Telemetry & Sleep Architecture (REM sleep % baseline vs post-stress)
Balance Beam Motor Learning Assay (35 trials over 7 days)

protocols.radiation_dose: 15 cGy (150 mSv) acute simplified 5-ion GCRsim combined with Social Isolation (SI)
protocols.telemetry: Continuous EEG, gross body activity, and core body temperature

diagnostic_explanation: Dual exposure to space radiation (150 mSv GCR) and prolonged social isolation degrades REM sleep recovery, elevates stress hormones, and impairs sensorimotor coordination.
